description: This is a CMake configuration script designed to locate the Nexus client library and headers. It attempts to find the Nexus client include directory and library, and if found, defines the imported target 'NXCLIENT::NXCLIENT' for use in the build system. It also handles error and status messaging based on whether the required library is found.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for the specified header file 'nexus_config.h' in the system include directories with optional path suffixes.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Searches for the specified library 'nxclient' in the system library paths.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes another CMake script or module, such as 'FindPackageHandleStandardArgs'.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Validates the results of 'find_path' and 'find_library', and sets variables indicating whether the package was successfully found.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to hide them from normal user interfaces.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates an imported library target 'NXCLIENT::NXCLIENT' if the Nexus client library is found.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties on the imported target, such as include directories and link interface languages.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Outputs messages of different severity levels, such as STATUS or FATAL_ERROR, during configuration.
